propositions: A new advisory 1-TURN criterion 'ac-satisfiability' in the 'coherence' facet must detect whether a ticket's acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, catching three contradiction shapes: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality.

The sibling roster sent to G3 must include each child's parsed acceptance-criteria items (via evaluate_plan_clarity), not only ids and titles, so G3 can audit whether the union of children covers each parent criterion.

The roster-building expression, currently duplicated in three places (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), must be single-sourced into a shared build_sibling_roster helper to prevent divergence between production and eval harnesses.

The rendered roster must place each child's acceptance-criteria items indented beneath its '- <id>: <title>' line, with a child carrying no parseable criteria keeping its line alone; the roster must be sent in the system prompt prefix (not per-pairing instructions) to avoid quadratic re-sending.
The roster's token cost must be included in the parent_tokens prefix estimate that feeds bin-packing and the warm-gate threshold, so budgets do not overflow when the roster is added to the prefix.
Nothing in src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/ changes because Pass-2's internal_conflict axis already grades the satisfiability defect; ac-satisfiability is a Pass-1 finding gate only.
